$comment: Player imagery for Game Script cards — REVIEW ASSETS (temporary until a licensed player-image source is chosen). Each image: `id`, the player, `team`, `slot` (pull-away = favourite dominant, control = favourite controlling, lead = the team's primary image), the publication's `participant_id`, a pinned Wikimedia Commons `commons_file` (free licence) and the CSS `focus`. scripts/players/fetch.mjs downloads pinned files only and credits them in src/lib/player-images.json. Players with no `commons_file` get a contact sheet instead. Gap: no free-licence photos found for James Cook III or Rhamondre Stevenson.
